# Assets Endpoints

Asset-centric orchestration, runs, partitions, and backfills.

## `GET /assets`

List assets

Returns first-class asset definitions visible to the authenticated principal.

- Operation ID: `listAssets`

### Query Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max_results` | `integer` | `false` | Maximum number of results to return per page. |

### Responses

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | Paginated list of assets |
